mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(max(id),0)::text || ':' || coalesce(sum(version),0)::text FROM fin_account_receivable WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT id AS source_id,company_id,partner_id,0::bigint AS warehouse_id,0::bigint AS sku_id,NULL::varchar AS batch_no, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS business_date,0::numeric AS quantity, 0::numeric AS reserved,0::numeric AS locked,0::numeric AS in_transit,amount,credited_amount AS reduction, written_off_amount AS settled,paid_amount AS paid FROM fin_account_receivable WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
